status: Integrated Prototype62 /0.62.0; headless verified; listening pending
authorization: Sean requested hit/death sounds, Storyboarding consultation and Engineering integration.
agreed_direction: Dry metal hit with short gauge rattle; heavier collapse with escaping pressure and loose metal.

event_contract.nonlethal: Only after actual positive HP reduction leaving HP>0 on perched_shooter. Choose one hit variant.
event_contract.death: At guarded finish_trial_defeat(actor), only perched_shooter, once per actual defeat. No hit cue on lethal blow.
event_contract.excluded: No firing, misses, invulnerable/no-damage contacts, corpse hits, despawn/offscreen cleanup or restored state.
event_contract.cooldown_scope: Per actor; death bypasses hit cooldown. Pause freezes cooldown.
event_contract.allocation: Separate bounded round-robin pools; never allocate per hit.
event_contract.variants: Alternate hit-a/hit-b locally; do not consume gameplay RNG.
event_contract.pause: Suspend/resume streams with explicit gameplay pause.
event_contract.cleanup: Stop all owned voices and clear hit cooldown state on retry, respawn, title and disposal.
event_contract.mute: Use existing Master SFX routing; respect SFX mute. Music-only mute must not suppress these cues.
event_contract.timing: Audio never gates damage, death animation, actor removal or control. Death tail may outlive corpse visual.

engineering.hooks: opening_trial_game.gd step_bullets and finish_trial_defeat; covers continuous Start inherited path.
